question.text: The minimum Average Daily Trading Volume (ADTV) required for non-agricultural commodities to qualify for at least 80% of a composite index weight is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.37, for composite indices at least 80% of index weight should comprise commodity futures with ADTV of at least Rs 75 crores for agri commodities and Rs 500 crores for non-agri commodities. The Trap: Rs 75 crores is the threshold for agricultural commodities, not non-agricultural. Rs 100 crores and Rs 250 crores are not specified thresholds. Note: Match the threshold to the commodity category: Rs 75 crores for agri, Rs 500 crores for non-agri.
